title: Kintup's marked logs test the Tsangpo river
summary: Sikkimese explorer Kintup spent years surveying the unknown Tsangpo gorge and released marked logs to test whether the Tsangpo becomes the Brahmaputra.
why: Helped solve where Tibet's great river flows.

unsung.contribution: Surveyed a previously unknown part of Tibet to show where the Tsangpo river went.
unsung.recognition: His accomplishment was not acknowledged until 1913.
